test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, July, September and December.

R travelled in September. Only one person travelled between R and T. No one travelled between U and P. P travelled in a month after U. More than two people travelled between P and S. Who among them travelled in July?
solution:
**Given: **

Six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, July, September and December.

Scheduling as per the given information:

1) R travelled in September.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c409c21c62451c07119df823e466d8a769fb350c6c386eb3ff3eaffd5a88290d.png] 

2) Only one person travelled between R and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/568885f3322df4960d07a0aba4b12ffb20b8b46c4c40ee27b0bcf26f07cefb9e.png] 

3) No one travelled between U and P. P travelled in a month after U.

 
• This is possible only when U travelled in January.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13cbab8c12b177f4ac928b5131a1f70556bdaa7c972962d00ae668a16602b8b5.png] 

4) More than two people travelled between P and S.

 
• This is possible only when S travelled in December.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de5b0e0420945f56b655b073dc641db38b1e9f77af32b11ce3e5762da61d3f6f.png] 

5) the last person Q can travel only in July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ee4b649d2fb69f213d9ffbabfe73353d7d3e1ab5eb25c31eb7661e4b734d199.png] 

Thus, '**Q'** among them travelled in July.

**Hence, 'Option 2' is correct.**
